identity.description: Central library symbol TLV62569PDDCR promoted from an unspecified board.

entries.evidence: First-import fit pass: TLV62569PDDCR (TI SLVSDG1C, DDC = TSOT-23-6 MO-193, LCSC C398365): pins vision-confirmed on p3 DDC top view and the p24 DDC0006A numbering (1 EN, 2 GND, 3 SW, 4 VIN, 5 PG open-drain, 6 FB) = symbol c9d15405, the L24 council converter glyph (D-10: flow-first + grafts G1-G6; 5 fresh regraders 4/4/3/4/4 x4 and 4/4/3/3/4 on QA page 12f73256). VIN/EN enter left, SW/FB/PG leave right with FB directly under SW (L25, no BST), GND at the bottom, so U3 (VIN->3V3) and U4 (3V3->1V8, EN sequencing, PG open-drain to STATUS_3V3) read left to right; internals show the P/N synchronous stage, DRV, 0.6V comparator and the PG open-drain FET. Land = stock Package_TO_SOT_SMD:TSOT-23-6 (sha 2b3e0975) with its stock TSOT-23-6.step; it fits DDC0006A p24/p25 (pitch 0.95, pads 1-3 / 4-6, no EP). Known open: pin.3.type / pin.6.type are single-source (guide #451, owner call); SYM-PINSET-MATCH is clean.
